## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] `refactor`: Code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] `perf`: Performance improvement
- [ ] `test`: Adding missing tests or correcting existing tests
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, build system, or dependencies update

## Quality Checklist
- [ ] TypeScript compilation passes with strict checks (`pnpm build` or `pnpm tsc --noEmit`)
- [ ] ESLint passes without errors (`pnpm lint`)
- [ ] Unit & integration tests pass (`pnpm test`)
- [ ] Light & Dark theme visual consistency verified
- [ ] No API keys, credentials, or secrets committed
